full_name: Emily Schwend | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Emily Schwend is a New York–based playwright whose work explores feminism, geographical specificity, and, occasionally, the supernatural world. Most recently, her play Utility, about an overworked and underpaid woman’s struggle for stability, was produced off Broadway in New York and subsequently won the 2016 Yale Drama Series Prize.
